Raw Singing Citrines are gems that can be used to upgrade the item level of Cyrce's Circlet by 3, up to a maximum item level of 658. For characters who are caught up, they will get one citrine per week from the next weekly quest. Characters who are behind can run weekly quests back-to-back until they catch up, or hope for a rare zone drop from any rare creature on the Siren Isle.

Razorwind Shores is a Horde-themed neighborhood zone, located off the coast of Durotar. It features biomes resembling the windswept bluffs of Durotar, the tropical beaches of the Echo Isles, and the autumnal forests of Azshara. Its Alliance-themed counterpart is Founder's Point.
Ready-Warm Portable Bakery is available for purchase at the Trading Post for 95 Trader's Tender.

The Reactive Webbed Escutcheon can drop from season-specific sources in delves. *During The War Within Season 1, it had a chance to drop from the Hulking Raptorial Claw dropped by Zekvir. *During The War Within Season 2, it had a chance to drop from a fully upgraded Nemesis Strongbox. *During The War Within Season 3, it had a chance to drop from the Shadowed Flickering Spoils which spawns in the treasure room after successfully defeating a Ky'veza's Shadow Clone (one of the few things that can spawn from a Flickergate). It can also drop from a Hidden Trove, the Great Vault, or the Cache of Delver's Spoils.
